## Rule

Single dot of color C at (r, c) in an HxW grid. Output: the dot moves DOWN one row to
(r+1, c); every cell in rows 0..r whose column matches the dot's column parity
(col % 2 == c % 2, within grid width) becomes color 4. Everything else background.

Corpus contract (verified on `corpus.build(199, want=200000)`, 2026-06-06):
- in_shapes 3x3..15x15, out_shapes == in_shapes — the 15x15 crop is provably safe (§CROP-CONTRACT).
- EXACTLY one non-background cell per input (nonzero-count min=max=1 on 200k).
- Dot colors {1,2,3,5,6,7,8,9} — never 4 (the fill color).
- Dot row r <= H-2 always (max(r-(H-1)) = -1): the moved dot never leaves the grid.
- Rule above reproduced ALL 200,000 outputs exactly in numpy.

## Algorithm sketch

```python
out = zeros_like(inp)                     # H x W
r, c = argwhere(inp != 0)[0]; C = inp[r][c]
out[0:r+1, [col for col in range(W) if col % 2 == c % 2]] = 4
out[r+1][c] = C
```

LIVE graph (`t199_shift_pixel_parity_fill`) implements this with a color+1 encoded plane
(bg-in-grid=1, padding=0, dot=C+1): dot mask = encoded > 1, fill rows via reverse CumSum of
per-row dot counts, fill cols via Equal(parity_vec, sum(dot_col_parity)) AND col-in-grid,
dot shift via Slice+Pad of the full dot plane, compose with two Wheres, one-hot via
Equal(encoded_out, [1..10]) and Pad to 30x30.

## Cost analysis

LIVE 16,157 = memory 16,103 + params 54. Dominated by `input_15` [1,10,15,15] F32 = 9,000
(56%) from Slice-then-Conv, plus `output_15_b` [1,10,15,15] BOOL 2,250 (Equal at 15x15
before the 30x30 Pad) and three F32 [1,1,15,15] planes at 900 each.

v4 3,172 = memory 3,107 + params 65 (static==profile; arcgen 266; confirmed 2026-06-12):
- All v3 logic unchanged; only the row-shift mechanism changes.
- Replace `Pad(Slice(row_dot_b), pad_row1[INT64 8])` with `Concat([false_row_init, Slice(row_dot_b)], axis=2)`.
- `pad_row1` INT64 [8] = 8 params; `false_row_init` BOOL [1,1,1,1] = 1 param. Net: -7 params.
- `false_row_init` is a BOOL [1,1,1,1] initializer (a single False element); Concat on axis=2
  with `row_head_b` [1,1,14,1] gives [1,1,15,1] correctly (False at row 0, old rows 0..13 at 1..14).
- Correctness guaranteed: corpus dot row r <= H-2 <= 13, so row_dot_b[14] is always False;
  the Slice(0,14) captures exactly the rows that can contain the dot.

v3 3,179 = memory 3,107 + params 72 (static; `_score_v2` exact per §39 MECHANISM):
- §41 negative-pad 1x1 Conv (`pads=[0,0,-15,-15]`, grader-confirmed) crops AND encodes
  straight off the free `input` plane — deletes the 9,000-B slice; `encoded` F32 = 900.
- Immediate Cast to `encoded_u8` (225); ALL vector machinery runs on U8: per-axis
  ReduceMax = 15-B vectors, Greater(u8) dot indicators, dot row via
  `Where(row_dot_b, iota1, 0) -> ReduceMax -> LessOrEqual` (1-BASED iota so the no-dot
  case is all-false = LIVE's reverse-CumSum semantics; no CumSum, no F32 casts),
  dot parity via `Where(col_dot_b, parity, 0) -> ReduceMax`, pixel color = 1-B
  ReduceMax of colmax_u8.
- Fill mask AND shifted dot are broadcast outer products of 15-element indicators
  (225 B each); the dot shift moves the ROW VECTOR (Slice+Pad of [1,1,15,1] = 29 B)
  instead of LIVE's full-plane shift (660 B). Relies on the single-dot invariant.
- Compose in UINT8 (`Where(bool,u8,u8)`, opset-13-confirmed): fill 225 + canvas 225;
  pad-to-30 in U8 = 900; final `Equal(canvas30_u8, [1..10])` IS the graph output
  (uncounted) — replaces LIVE's 2,250-B BOOL Equal-then-Pad.

Floor pressure for this architecture: 900 (one float color plane at 15x15) + 225 (U8 cast)
+ 900 (pre-output 30x30 U8) + 450 (two 225-B broadcast masks) + 450 (two 225-B U8 Wheres)
+ ~96 vectors/scalars + ~65 params ≈ 3,086 (v4 sits 86 above it at 3,172; the shift-vector
section contributes 14+15=29 B memory + 3+1=4 params = 33 total). Cheaper would need a
different uncounted-output trick; Sub-3k not reachable in this family.

**v9_E 1,402 = memory 1,270 + params 132 (static==profile on `--arcgen 266`, 2026-06-21; CURRENT BEST).**
Same v7 free-output Einsum `tc,tr,tw,qw,b->bcrw`; two byte-equal trims off v7:
- dot-channel in F16: `Cast(color_f)->color_h [1,10]=20` then `Sub(color_h, active_ch2_h)` makes `dot_ch_h`
  directly, deleting the F32 `dot_ch_f` [1,10]=40 (−20).
- parity by Einsum: `psum_f=Einsum(col_dot_f, parity_f, "bw,xw->bx")` (scalar dot-col parity) then
  `Equal(parity_f, psum_f)` — deletes `c_idx`+`c_parity` (INT64 8 each) and `parity_i64`(30)+`two_i64`(1)
  params; adds `psum_f`(4) and reuses one `parity_f`[1,30] F32 init for both ops (−13).
**Floor proof (Einsum family, sub-1000 unreachable):** residual is 3 irreducible F32 input-reductions
(`row_any_f` 120, `row_dot_f` 120, `col_dot_f` 120, `color_f` 40 — ReduceMax/Einsum preserve the F32
input dtype; F16-casting the input is the forbidden 18,000-B path) plus the two stacked F16 operand banks
`row_terms_h` 180 + `col_extra_terms_h` 180 (must be single tensors; splitting into per-term outer products
makes [1,10,30,30] F16 intermediates = 18,000 B each). The 3 terms are structurally minimal (3 distinct
spatial supports, no two share a conjunctive support — confirmed numerically). Rejected (measured): reverse-
CumSum row gates (F32 [1,30]=120/gate > current INT/BOOL path), bool-bank single-cast for the row bank
(materializes [3,30] bool + forces Slice for qw), folding qw into the col bank via Mul ([3,30]=180 intermediate).

v7 1,435 = memory 1,302 + params 133 (static==profile on `--arcgen 266`, 2026-06-20):
- Drops the U8 carrier/canvas family entirely. The final graph output is one signed F16
  `Einsum("tc,tr,tw,qw,b->bcrw")` over three terms: active background, fill delta
  (-ch0+ch4), and moved-dot delta (-ch0+chC).
- Uses the singleton-dot marginals `row_dot_f` and `col_dot_f` plus `ArgMax` to recover
  `(r,c)`, then compares against fixed iota/parity vectors. This is generator-safe:
  200k truth confirms exactly one dot and square grids in the real distribution.
- Uses the square-grid invariant to reuse `row_any` as the active-column gate. This deletes
  the separate `col_any_f` vector from the conservative free-output probe.
- Dominant charged tensors: `row_terms_h` 180, `col_extra_terms_h` 180,
  `row_any_f`/`row_dot_f`/`col_dot_f` 120 each, and five F16 vector casts/stacks at 60 each.
  The full `[1,10,30,30]` tensor is only the exempt graph output.
- Rejected probes: v5 conservative F32 free-output passed visible but cost 2,105
  (memory 2,002 + params 103); v6 INT8-factor free-output had attractive static shape
  (932 memory) but ORT has no `Einsum(INT8)` implementation and fails visible/load.

**Final-op factorization lemma (2026-06-06, task148-style)** — the 900-B pre-output
canvas cannot be replaced by a cheaper free-`output` producer:
- `And(a[1,10,30,1], b[1,1,1,30])` outer product (600 B of inputs): requires every
  channel separable as A[k,i] ∧ B[k,j]. Channels 3 (fill = row_le×parity_in) and C-1
  (dot = row_next×col_dot) ARE separable, but channel 0 is
  `in_grid ∧ ¬fill ∧ ¬dot` — a row/col MIX that no single conjunctive outer product
  expresses. ✗
- `Where(rowgate[1,1,30,1], top[1,10,1,30], bot[1,10,1,30])`: the output has THREE
  row-classes (fill rows / dot row / below-dot rows), Where gives two; nesting forces a
  [1,10,30,30] intermediate = 9,000. ✗
- `Equal(rowcodes[1,10,30,1], colcodes[1,1,1,30])`: fill rows need MANY true columns,
  the dot row needs exactly ONE at a data-dependent column — column codes can't satisfy
  both (iota codes give ≤1 match; parity codes can't isolate column c). ✗
- Arithmetic compose (base + 4·fill + (pix−1)·dot via u8 Add/Mul): 1,221 B vs the
  1,125-B Where chain AND needs opset 14. ✗

## Don't-do log

- Do not retry the 2026-05-20 F16/cast-placement family (whole_f16, cast-after-slice/
  input-consumers/conv, drop-final-cast): no valid cost win; CumSum has no F16 kernel.
- Do not crop below 15x15: corpus in_shapes reach exactly 15x15 (200k check 2026-06-06).
- Do not cast `input` to F16 to get an F16 Conv plane: the cast intermediate is
  [1,10,30,30] = 18,000 B and dwarfs the 450-B saving on `encoded`.
- Do not one-hot at 15x15 then Pad (LIVE's layout): Equal output [1,10,15,15] BOOL =
  2,250 B vs 225 (U8 canvas) + 900 (U8 pad-to-30) = 1,125 for the same result.
- Do not replace the outer-product shifted-dot/parity vectors with LIVE-faithful
  full-plane machinery "for safety" without need: +406 B minimum, and v1 is already
  byte-equal to LIVE on all 266 officials + 200k corpus. Multi-dot inputs (where they
  diverge) are generator-impossible; `add_isolated_cell` adversarial 59/266 documents
  the divergence and is advisory-only noise per core.md.
- Do not bother with `polish_candidate.py` on v1/v2: confirmed no-op (onnxsim, safe_opt,
  const_to_init, clip_mul_to_min, scalar_broadcast_ones, slice_axis_collapse) 2026-06-06.
- Do not use 0-BASED iota for the rows<=r compare (the v2 bug class): with no dot in the
  crop, `r_s=0` makes row 0 pass the row gate and diverge from LIVE on off-contract
  inputs (adv shift 947/1064). 1-based iota (v3) fixes it at identical cost.
- The Einsum-from-input vector route (`bchw,c->bh`-family for dot row/col + `bchw->bw`/
  `bchw->bh` for in-grid + `bchw->bc` for color) does NOT win: full pricing lands at
  ≈3,225 vs v3's 3,179 — Einsum cannot crop (every vector is 30-wide, 120 B F32) and
  killing the encoded passthrough forces an in-grid outer product + base-canvas Where
  (two extra 225-B planes). Dead end, do not retry.
- Micro-trims priced and rejected (risk-per-byte-poor on a byte-equal primary):
  Gather-rotate row shift instead of Slice+Pad (-10 net), reduce-all instead of
  axes-input on the parity ReduceSum (v1-only, -1 param), Mod-computed parity vector
  (+1 net). The remaining ~86 B over the ~3,093 architecture floor is in this class.
- Min/Max-algebra compose (in_grid = Min(row_in1, col_in1) outer product; fillval5 =
  Min(row_le5, parity_in5); canvas = Max chain; dot via Min(row_next_pix, col_dot_pix)):
  priced 3,317 (+210 vs v3). The plane count nets equal (1,125) but v3's encoded_u8 cast
  is DUAL-USE (Where passthrough + u8 reductions in one 225-B tensor) — any compose that
  drops the passthrough must rebuild in-grid as a 225-B outer product AND moves the
  per-axis reductions back to F32 (60 B each) or adds casts. Do not retry.
- Wide-kernel Conv per-axis vectors (kernel [1,10,1,15] / [1,10,15,1] emitting [15,1]
  row/col sums directly, skipping the 900-B plane): kernel params scale with spatial
  taps — 150 per axis vs conv_w's 10 — and SUM (not MAX) detection needs a
  data-dependent width threshold. Dead on params alone.
- Rank-2 planes to shrink the two 8-param Pad initializers: Conv is NCHW rank-4; every
  de-rank (Squeeze/Reshape, before or after the cast) materializes a duplicate plane
  (+225 or +900) to save 8 params. Dead.
- Do NOT replace false_row_init [1,1,1,1] BOOL with ConstantOfShape: it costs a shape_input
  tensor init (e.g., INT64 [4] = 4 params) + 1 B runtime intermediate = net worse.
- ArgMax(rowmax_u8) as replacement for Where+ReduceMax to get r_s: ArgMax gives 0-based
  index r; no-dot case gives ArgMax=0, then r_s_u8=Cast(0)=0, Add(0,1)=1, and
  LessOrEqual(iota1, 1) = True for row 0 — wrong (should be all-False). The current
  Where(row_dot_b, iota1, 0)+ReduceMax = 0 for no-dot, LessOrEqual(iota1, 0) = all-False is
  correct. ArgMax route costs more intermediates (INT64+Cast+Add) and is semantically wrong.
